About Jared Gibbons
Which areas of Ladner should I look at for houses?

Buyers usually look in East Ladner, Port Guichon, Neilsen Grove, Holly, Hawthorne or Ladner Village. Lot sizes, house ages and price points differ from one pocket to the next, so I fit the area to what you can spend and how far you commute.
What schools serve Ladner?

This part of Ladner belongs to Delta School District 37, with Delta Secondary and the Neilson Grove, Hawthorne and Holly elementaries nearby. School catchments follow the address, so check the exact school with the district prior to buying.
How is transit and commuting from Ladner?
Ride a Ladner Exchange bus to Bridgeport or the Richmond-Brighouse Canada Line, or drive Hwy 17/99 to reach the George Massey crossing quickly.
What zoning rules affect houses in Ladner?
Most detached lots have Delta RS zoning. East Ladner has large farm parcels within the ALR. Inside town, the small-scale multi-unit rules from Bill 44 apply.
What should I check before buying a detached house in Ladner?
Houses come with freehold title and no strata fees, plus space for a suite or garden. Before subjects come off, I go through the documents with you.
Are first-time buyer exemptions available in Ladner?
Yes. A qualifying buyer can claim the First-Time Home Buyers' property transfer tax exemption in BC and also use the federal FHSA. My first-time buyer guide lists the current thresholds.
